entities.name: PMID:25087996
observations: In rat VSMCs loaded with Chol:MβCD, 3 μmol/L ezetimibe decreased total, esterified, and free cholesterol; it increased caveolin-1 and reduced SREBP-1 expression/nuclear translocation and phospho-ERK1/2. PD98059 produced similar changes, suggesting MAPK involvement.

entities.name: Ezetimibe lowers VSMC cholesterol
observations: In cholesterol-loaded primary rat VSMCs, ezetimibe lowered intracellular total, esterified, and free cholesterol; dose-dependent phospho-ERK1/2 reduction and similar effects of PD98059 support, but do not definitively establish, MAPK mediation.

entities.name: Ezetimibe
observations: At 3 μmol/L, decreased cholesterol measures in Chol:MβCD-loaded rat VSMCs in vitro (PMID:25087996).

entities.name: ERK1/2
observations: Phospho-ERK1/2 decreased dose-dependently with ezetimibe in cholesterol-loaded rat VSMCs; PD98059 had similar effects on cholesterol-related readouts and regulatory proteins (PMID:25087996).
